example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মেজে ঘষে সুন্দরী, তার আসল রূপ দেখলে সবাই হতাশ হবে।
এই ছবিতে মেজে ঘষে সুন্দরী দেখাচ্ছে, কিন্তু বাস্তবে নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a fake beauty, all dolled up with no real charm underneath.
That model looks like a painted beauty in the photo, but in reality, she's plain.
history: This idiom likely originates from traditional rural Bengali practices of applying oil and rubbing to enhance skin appearance, critiquing superficial beauty enhancements.
note: Refers to artificial beautification through oil massages, common in folk culture.
